explanation: It is non-zero only at D1, and only when the previous trial ended in state S1 and was rewarded (whatever was chosen, common or rare); then it is about 8 for trials up to about 60, 9 for trials 60-90 and 10 for trials past 90. It is 0 at D1 after a reward in S2, 0 after any unrewarded trial (at most 1), and always 0 at GO and D2.
